def filter_api_calls(log_probs_without, log_probs_with, log_weights, tau_filter):
    """
    Filter API call candidates based on loss improvement.

    Parameters
    ----------
    log_probs_without : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log probabilities of future tokens without the API call (nonpositive).
    log_probs_with : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log probabilities of future tokens with the API call (nonpositive).
    log_weights : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates, future_horizon)
        Log of the weighting factors for each future position (nonpositive).
    tau_filter : float
        Threshold for the weighted margin (nonnegative finite).

    Returns
    -------
    keep_mask : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates,), dtype bool
        Boolean mask indicating which candidates to keep.
    margins : np.ndarray, shape (n_candidates,), dtype float
        Weighted margins for each candidate.
    """
    # Validate input matrices
    for name, mat in [("log_probs_without", log_probs_without),
                      ("log_probs_with", log_probs_with),
                      ("log_weights", log_weights)]:
        if not isinstance(mat, np.ndarray) or mat.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")

    shape = log_probs_without.shape
    if log_probs_with.shape != shape or log_weights.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All three input matrices must have the same shape")

    if shape[0] == 0 or shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")

    if not (np.isfinite(log_probs_without).all() and
            np.isfinite(log_probs_with).all() and
            np.isfinite(log_weights).all()):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must contain finite values")

    if (log_probs_without > 0).any() or (log_probs_with > 0).any() or (log_weights > 0).any():
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must be nonpositive")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Threshold must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("Threshold must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute weighted margins
    weights = np.exp(log_weights)
    margins = np.sum((log_probs_with - log_probs_without) * weights, axis=1)
    keep_mask = margins > tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margins"}
